title: ENIGMA R.D.E. machine one: compensator, socket bar and switch knob trial
material: PLA Basic · right 0.4 mm · compensator supports only

source.evidence: Prepared on current main after checking all open PRs and relevant inventory feedback. Exact retained-mesh artifact audit passed. The downloaded printer copy matched the reviewed archive byte for byte.

notes: One rear-left compensator, one socket bar and one single-colour switch knob fit sample. Black PLA Basic A3, right 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.15 mm layers (0.20 mm first), three walls, 15% infill, 5 mm brims and 220 °C / 55 °C textured PEI. Supports on the compensator only. Socket-bar bridge direction 90°. The knob still needs a contrasting indicator for the final assembly. Staged for after the current print and bed clearance. Physical fit is pending. Geometry from HdM Project ENIGMA R.D.E., Prof. Dr. Simon Wiest, revision 397ca89, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Superseded for dispatch on 19 November. A3 is empty and the same-PLA compensator supports do not meet the new PVA build requirement.
